backlog.evidence: Canonical text_quiet #706B65 is used for 11px metadata and measures approximately 3.68:1 on surface_raised #0D0D0D and 3.80:1 on surface #080808, below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA threshold for normal-size text.

backlog.title: Add explicit Obsidian vault export service with atomic writes and conflict policy
backlog.evidence: Current candidate contains deterministic Obsidian Markdown projection only. Repository search for vault export/write/atomic/conflict implementation returned no result, and TASK-0002 explicitly records writable vault export as follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: export is opt-in and targets an explicitly selected local vault path
writes are atomic and never partially replace an existing note
existing-file conflicts use an explicit deterministic policy rather than silent overwrite
canonical Knowledge data remains source of truth and export failures do not mutate it
verification_plan: unit tests for atomic write success/failure and conflict cases
path traversal and invalid vault tests
targeted Windows filesystem test because rename/replace semantics are platform-relevant

backlog.title: Define cryptographic plugin publisher identity before publisher metadata becomes a trust signal
backlog.evidence: TASK-0004 records publisher metadata as descriptive only and explicitly notes that cryptographic publisher identity/signature verification does not exist. Repository search for plugin signature/publisher identity/verification returned no implementation.
acceptance_criteria: plain publisher display text is never treated as authenticated identity
signed identity format and trust root policy are explicit and versioned
invalid/unknown signatures fail closed without loading executable plugin code
canonical identity comparison is resistant to display-text spoofing
verification_plan: positive and negative signature fixture tests
unknown signer and revoked/untrusted signer tests

backlog.title: Add deterministic visual-regression comparison for canonical 11-surface desktop capture
backlog.evidence: TASK-0009 notes that the 11/11 screenshot workflow proves renderability but does not objectively pixel-review appearance. Repository search for visual-diff/screenshot-baseline/image-regression comparison returned no implementation.
acceptance_criteria: comparison is deterministic under a pinned rendering environment
all 11 canonical surfaces are mapped to named baselines
thresholds distinguish antialiasing noise from meaningful layout/color regressions
failure output identifies surface and produces inspectable diff evidence
baseline updates are explicit and cannot happen automatically on test failure
verification_plan: self-test with identical images must pass
known changed pixel/layout fixture must fail
Windows harness integration remains exact-SHA bound
